messages:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling a multi-service wave for the next change window Thu 2026-03-26 02:00 UTC. Need alignment on pins/rollback criteria for API, runtime, Console, and Router. Proposed pins: api=2.3.0-rc3, runtime=1.14.0, console=3.2.1, router=2.0.0. Canary approach: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~45m. Any blockers?
jamie: Can we add a runtime fallback to quantized v1.13.5 if we see latency regressions? Also suggest disabling autoscale bursts for Dedicated during canary.
rafa: FYI runtime v1.14 changes model shard layout; we should run KV-cache warmup and a dry-run on staging before any traffic shift.
deploy-bot: Deployment plan created: plan id=plan-1923, scheduled Thu 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z. Steps: 1) console patch -> 2) router update -> 3) api staged -> 4) runtime canary -> 5) ramp. Rollback hooks attached and health checks configured.
alex-devex: I'll publish a short runbook and add explicit rollback steps to release notes. Quick Q: what's the automated rollback threshold?
sr-oncall: Rollback triggers we'll use: error rate spike >1% sustained for 5m, p99 latency >500ms for 5m, or model-quality regression detected by smoke-eval failing >2/20 prompts. Also monitor 5xx spikes.
simon-console: Console change is UI-only and backwards compatible. Safe to push first. It reads new model-id header but tolerates older values.
maria: OK locking pins now. Pin snippet attached: ```pins:\n  api: 2.3.0-rc3\n  runtime: 1.14.0\n  console: 3.2.1\n  router: 2.0.0\n``` I'll attach to the plan in the release doc.
rafa: For runtime canary please add a KV warmup job before shifting traffic: `curl -XPOST https://staging-infra/internal/warmup -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","shards":8}'`
ops-bot: Noted change window conflict: infra kernel patch scheduled same day at 02:30 UTC on prod-gpu-3. Recommend moving canary earlier or coordinate with infra.
jamie: We can shift runtime canary earlier to 01:45 UTC to avoid the infra patch. Any objections?
simon-console: :thumbsup: no objections from Console team.
maria: Shifting plan. Updated plan id=plan-1923a. New timeline: console @01:00, router @01:10, api staged @01:30, runtime canary @01:45, ramp 01:45-02:30. deploy-bot will update the scheduled jobs.
deploy-bot: plan updated plan-1923a. Canary settings: initial 5% (single AZ) for 15m, expand to 25% for 20m, then 100% over 10m. Automated rollback window: health checks + rule engine (120s cooloff) + manual abort allowed.
alex-devex: Release notes draft uploaded and linked to the runbook. Who owns the post-deploy smoke tests and verification?
jamie: I'll own API & Router smoke checks. Rafael will own runtime sanity tests. Maria will validate Console.
rafa: I'll run KV warmup + stress-run and paste commands into runbook before canary.
maria: Acceptance criteria for green: p50 latency delta <15ms, p95 <50ms, error rate <0.3%, no regressions on smoke eval set. If any threshold breached we trigger rollback.
sr-oncall: I'll be on watch during the window. Paging rota: @sr-oncall and @oncall-infra to be present.
alex-devex: Release notes and short QA checklist posted: https://confluence/internal/releases/1923a. I added links to dashboards and playbooks.
maria: Final checklist: any DB/schema migrations? none. Any data-plane changes? Router will add header `x-model-variant: v2` for routing logic.
jamie: Router change is header-only and backwards compatible; old services ignore header.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintain a 1-hour quiet window post-ramp for monitoring before scheduling other changes on the same fleet.
simon-console: Console patch deployed to staging; smoke looks clean. No obvious client-side regressions.
deploy-bot: Dry-run for runtime canary executed in staging, warmup succeeded, health checks passed.
maria: Great — proceeding with plan-1923a unless someone raises a blocker. If you see anything urgent, post here. :eyes:\n
